source.name: Footy Headlines – 'Uzbekistan 2026 World Cup Home & Away Kits Released'
source.note: Kit maker. The 2026 World Cup home-kit launch article; its photos (front, side and back of the shirt, and the shorts and socks composite) show no commercial logo anywhere on the kit: only the UFA crest and the 7SABER maker mark. World Cup match regulations also bar shirt sponsors.
source.quote: The Uzbekistan Football Association (UFA) and local sportswear brand 7SABER have officially unveiled the national team’s new home and away kits for the 2026 World Cup.

summary: 7SABER home kit for the 2026 World Cup cycle (Uzbekistan's first World Cup). No commercial shirt sponsors: the kit-launch photos (front, back, sleeves, shorts, socks) show only the UFA crest and the 7SABER maker mark. 7SABER is the kit maker.
headline: The shirt is {level}: it carries no commercial sponsors. 7SABER makes the kit.
